Morrowind and Bladur's Gate (1 & 2) - They have some similarities, although Morrowind is an ARPG and Baldur's Gate is a classic isometric RPG, they both rely on dice rolls to determine hits and damage. In Morrowind the rolls are hidden from the user which can cause frustration due to the first person viewpoint. Regardless, if you're looking for story- Morrowind has it in spades. Each Great House of the Dunmer have their own storylines, along with the main story there will be plenty for you to do. Baldur's Gate is a bit more linear, but you still have freedom to explore and do quests as you find them. Both games have quite a bit of replay value as well, since there are many paths you may take to your goal. I highly recommend both!
